_comment: Production overrides for the FishMMO Control Panel. Kestrel binds loopback only; TLS terminates at NGINX. Database credentials come from FISHMMO_DB_USERNAME / FISHMMO_DB_PASSWORD or /etc/fishmmo/db-secrets.env, and ConnectionStrings__NpgsqlConnection must be set (with Ssl Mode=Require) or the host refuses to start. Do not commit real credentials here.
